general_knowledge_routing.description: Defines patterns for routing queries directly to the GENERAL knowledge track (LLM world knowledge). Checked BEFORE the main datasource router to save API token costs. Matching is whole-word only and limited by the guards below (see app/services/small_talk_classifier.py).

strong_general_indicators.description: A short query that is essentially one of these phrases goes to the GENERAL track immediately.

guards.description: Safety limits so a real data question is never mistaken for small talk. When a guard blocks the shortcut, the LLM router decides as usual.

general_knowledge_routing.llm_fallback_instruction: If none of the above heuristic indicators match the incoming query, pass the query to the main LLM router layer (gpt-4o-mini) to decide between DB, FILES, API, and GENERAL based on semantic context.
